selection: independently published Ground Zero source explicitly received by the Illuci candidate
sourceOwnership: Ground Zero owns its Constitution, Bill and methods. Illuci owns these runtime adaptations and observations. The source snapshot is immutable attribution, not a maintained duplicate Constitution or an authority grant.

provisions.behavior: selected verification/evidence applicability instruction reaches non-raw model input
provisions.limit: the instruction does not execute tests or establish result truth

provisions.behavior: review can cause one correction turn; response/latency outcomes update implemented adaptive routing components
provisions.limit: streaming does not feed every reliability counter; no automatic source updater shipped

provisions.tier: host admission + consumed context + retained observations
provisions.behavior: host-admitted memory is fresh per turn; retained session/agent observations can feed later topology frames
provisions.limit: no identity authorization is inferred from a path, label or checksum

provisions.behavior: selected consequential creation requires current source-fit facts and existing responsibility inadequacy
provisions.limit: ordinary missing Bill behavior and optional soft verification remain separately documented

provisions.behavior: tool permission, allowlist and workspace checks retain their source-owned meanings
provisions.limit: read-shaped metadata or a record does not supply a new grant

provisions.behavior: dependency reach does not elevate version credit; explicit evidenced scope distinguishes correction, increment, completed feature and operator-selected completed group
provisions.limit: record presence does not verify facts or authenticate authority; no version is changed by the classifier

provisions.consumer: CONTRIBUTING.md and public Git/PR/release metadata review
provisions.behavior: public attribution centers the human and developed system without provider/model coauthors or generated-by labels
provisions.limit: functional compatibility identifiers, required legal notices and relevant technical provenance remain accurate; this statement is not universal runtime prevention

reciprocalChange: Engine findings can propose a Ground Zero source revision; both repositories independently review and receive the change.
sourcePublication: Ground Zero independently published and received; this manifest binds its immutable source without merging project ownership
